acceptanceCriteria: Fixture change to foo_client.rb selects both foo_client_spec and baz_service_spec with advisory constant-edge witnesses
ruby:rails-autoload frontier is replaced by edges and retained only for dynamic constant lookup (constantize, const_get)
rails_helper/spec_helper are not test units; a change to them or spec/support/** selects every spec
Go and Python affected graph bytes are unchanged; RUBY-AFFECTED-V0 amended with numbered requirements and tests
body: GitHub #1130 item 3. liveverify/affected/ruby/ruby.go uses requires plus a path counterpart and raises the ruby:rails-autoload frontier (:173-175), never using constant edges, so scope stays UNKNOWN. Repro: fixture edit of foo_client.rb excludes spec/services/bar/baz_service_spec with NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT although Bar::BazService calls FooClient, and treats spec/rails_helper as a test unit. Depends on the S1 mapper package.
title: GH #1130 S2: Ruby affected narrows from autoload constant edges instead of the rails-autoload frontier
